title: Test taste is Steering, and every Steering file exists

statements.says: A team's taste in tests moves out of tdd to a new rule, docs/agents/rules/testing.md, and its Seed carries today's words.
The taste in tests that moves is what to mock, which fake library, one assertion per test, test names, and integration style over unit style.
tdd keeps the method: red before green, vertical slices, tests at seams through public interfaces, and the anti-patterns.
The test-first loop stays Machinery.
tdd states its seams and goes on, and never waits for a yes.
The Fakes section leaves the determinism rule for the testing rule, so mocking lives in one place.
tdd stops when the testing rule is missing, as comment-sweep stops without the comments rule.
Every Steering file always exists.
Setup writes each missing Steering file, even a file the team deleted.
A team that wants less of a Steering file empties it down.
The loop's preflight stops before any ticket runs when a file setup seeds is missing, and it reads the same list seed-steering writes from.
Until a team runs setup again after a Plugin update, the loop stops at its preflight with a message that says to run setup, and never stops in the middle of a ticket.
tdd held a team's taste in tests and read no Steering, so a change to that taste had to reach the skill as well as a team's rule, and a team could not edit it.
Because tdd stops when the testing rule is missing, every Steering file has to always exist.
A Plugin update reaches a team before its Steering does.
Making test-first a lever was rejected, because the loop's quality rests on red before green and making every opinion a lever had already been turned down.

Putting the taste in an on-demand file that only tdd reads was rejected: it costs less, because a rule loads into every Session, but the fix step writes tests without calling tdd, and a rule reaches every step that writes a test.

Letting tdd go on with the method alone when the rule is missing was rejected, because a missing rule means setup has not run since the rule joined the Seeds and the fix is to run it, and a skill that quietly drops the team's taste hides that.
Letting a deleted Steering file stay deleted was rejected, because a step that needs the file would then stop in the middle of a ticket, and setup could never repair it.
A fakes setting that names the fake library was rejected for now, because no check reads it so it would only be prose in another place, and a setting joins the day a check needs one.
This replaces one line of the Machinery list in the decision that a team steers its taste and not the method: the test-first loop in tdd stays there, and the taste in tests leaves it.
